title: Induced Wiggle in Cylinder (Optics Puzzle)
full_prompt: Write a ManimGL script to visualize the propagation of a polarized light wave through a sugar solution cylinder, demonstrating optical rotation. Create a 3D scene with coordinate axes and a background plane. Define a custom 'SugarCylinder' class inheriting from Cylinder that aligns with the x-axis, has a semi-transparent blue color, and uses camera-based depth sorting. Define a 'TwistedRibbon' class inheriting from ParametricSurface to represent the rotating polarization state of the light wave as a 3D ribbon with a specified amplitude and twist rate. Implement a 'PropagatingRings' class inheriting from VGroup that animates concentric circles expanding outwards along the propagation path using a custom updater. Finally, define a 'Polarizer' class to represent a polarizing filter. Combine these elements into a single 3D scene where the camera rotates to show the spatial structure of the twisted ribbon inside the cylinder.

visual_techniques: Custom 3D Cylinder with transparency and camera sorting
Dynamic propagating rings using frame-by-frame updaters

common_failure_modes.pattern: always_sort_to_camera is missing or throws AttributeError in standard Manim Community
common_failure_modes.note: This method is exclusive to the ManimGL/3b1b fork. In ManimCE, 3D transparency sorting is handled automatically by the modernGL renderer or requires manual z-index adjustments.
The parameter 'prefered_creation_axis' is specific to ManimGL and will cause errors in standard ManimCE.
This is a ManimGL-specific optimization for 3D stroke rendering and should be omitted or handled conditionally in ManimCE.
